context: A boss introduces a uni intern to an engineering team
purpose: Teach: 本田/石田/安田/川口/神田/大塚/野口/高木

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、こちらが本田部長、隣が石田課長、後ろが安田主任、川口先輩、神田リーダー。
lines.en: Ren, this is Director Honda over there; next to him is Chief Ishida; and behind them are Supervisor Yasuda, Kawaguchi, and Leader Kanda.
lines.style: Steady, authoritative pace. Point and name with clarity—no rush. Each introduction lands with the weight of introduction. Warm baseline beneath the formality. This is orientation, not interrogation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 初めまして、よろしくお願いします。
lines.en: It's a pleasure to meet you all. I look forward to working with you.
lines.style: Respectful bow in the voice. Careful diction, slightly slower than conversational. Genuine—not performed. A small pause before each clause to show he means it, not just saying it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 大塚さんがデータ分析、野口さんが品質、高木さんがAI担当だ。
lines.en: Otsuka handles data analysis; Noguchi is quality; Takagi leads the AI division.
lines.style: Clinical efficiency. Each role lands on the same beat. Hiroshi is cataloguing, not elaborating. Comfortable silence between phrases. Speaking to someone he's already assessing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: I really appreciate that. There's a lot to learn.
lines.style: Soft, genuine gratitude. Slight breath intake before speaking—gathering resolve. Ren is absorbing, not just listening. Quieter than the bow, more personal. A touch of nervous energy underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: まずは、各部署を一週間ずつ回ってもらう。
lines.en: First, you'll spend a week rotating through each department.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact instruction. Slight forward momentum—this is the plan, this is how it goes. No debate, but no harshness either. The tone of someone laying out a path he's walked before.
